The abandoned Bog Town '''Red Rocket''' is an [[Fallout 76 locations|unmarked location]] situated in the [[Cranberry Bog]] region of [[Appalachia]].

==Background==
Once a nuclear [[Coolant (Fallout 4)|coolant]] replenishment and service station before the [[Great War]], it now sits abandoned and uninhabited.

==Layout==
When approaching the town from the west, the [[Red Rocket]] station is situated on the righthand side, next to [[Adelaide's Diner]] on the outskirts of town. The location contains one's [[My stash box|stash]] and a weapons workbench in a shack behind the station, near a large [[Wood (Fallout 76)|wood pile]]. A camp has been set up on the roof, overlooking [[Fallout 76 roadways|Highway 65]]. It is accessible by a makeshift ramp, with a bear trap immediately as one steps onto the roof. A second bear trap is located closer to the front edge.

Two [[Raiders (Fallout 76)|raiders]] lay dead in the corner, next to a large pile of tires. Odds and ends such as blocks, a [[fuel tank]], clown figurines, and six [[Atomic Roller ball (Fallout 76)|atomic roller balls]]. The figurines are set up like bowling pins, with a roller ball interspersed within them. A derelict [[Pick-R-Up truck (Fallout 76)|Pick-R-Up truck]] sits beyond the fuel pumps on the highway. 

==Appearances==
The abandoned Bog Town Red Rocket appears only {{In|FO76}}.

The '''Woods Estate''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the [[Toxic Valley]] region of [[Appalachia]].

==Background==
The Woods Estate was the pre-War home of [[Arthur Wood|Arthur]], [[Molly Wood|Molly]] and [[Freddy Wood]].<ref>[[Woods Estate terminal entries#Molly|Woods Estate terminal entries; Molly]]</ref> After Freddy Wood escaped from being kidnapped by [[Otis Pike]], he returned to his family home shortly before [[Great War|the bombs fell]]. This was where he was collected by a [[Vault-Tec Corporation|Vault-Tec]] representative and brought to a local vault, as arranged by his father.<ref>[[Freddy's hasty note]]</ref>

==Layout==
The Woods Estate is mostly destroyed by 2102 and consists of a collapsing house, greenhouse, and an inaccessible garage. The greenhouse contains a [[petrified corpse]] and assorted gardening-related junk, such as [[flower pot]]s and [[Bag of fertilizer (Fallout 76)|bags of fertilizer]]. The main house has been gutted already and the only items of interest are three [[Ammo box (Fallout 76)|ammo box]]es, a [[Woods Estate terminal entries|terminal]], and a picture of Freddy Wood on a dresser on the upper floor. A few [[Crater Raiders|raiders]] may mill around the back of the greenhouse, scavenging containers.

==Notable loot==
* [[Freddy's hasty note]] - Note, in a desk with a terminal on it upstairs, obtainable during [[Cold Case]].

==Appearances==
The Woods Estate appears only {{In|FO76}}.

[[Early Warnings]] |terminal =[[Relay tower HN-B1-12 terminal entries|Emergency management system relay terminal]] |cell name =RelayTower02Ext |refid ={{ID|00262a88}} |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeon}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeonPOI}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeClearable}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionForestFloodlands}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScaleSmall}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeOutdoors}} * {{Location keyword FO76|ChallengeLocTypeRelayStation}} |edid =LocForestRelayTower02Location }} '''Relay tower HN-B1-12''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in [[the Forest]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Layout== This location is a standard radio relay tower with [[machinegun turret]]s guarding its entrances, formerly controlled by the [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]].[[Letter to Linda]] Inside is a blue [[Relay tower HN-B1-12 terminal entries|system relay terminal]] which US government supply requisition holotapes can be loaded into to call for supply drops. There is a bank of lockers along its southwestern wall and a locked [[Footlocker (Fallout 76)|footlocker]] ([[Picklock]] 0) and [[Ammo box (Fallout 76)|ammo box]] in the corner of the room. There is also a [[First aid (Fallout 76)|first aid]] next to its southeast entrance. ==Notable loot== * [[Letter to Linda]] - Note, down the road in a military [[off-road vehicle]] in the hand of a skeleton. * [[US government supply requisition]] - Holotape, on the blue console behind a metal shelf with a radio. * Potential [[Vault-Tec bobblehead (Fallout 76)|Vault-Tec bobblehead]] - Inside the building, on the small mainframe computer bank. * Potential [[Fallout 76 magazines|magazine]] - Inside the building, on top of the mainframe computer terminal attached to the central pillar, facing southwest (if looking at the middle pillar). ==Related quest== * [[Request Government Air Drop]]: A [[US government supply requisition]] holotape can be used in the relay tower terminal. ==Appearances== Relay tower HN-B1-12 appears only {{In|FO76}}. ==Gallery== F76 Relay Tower HN-B1-12.png|At night FO76 Letter to Linda.png|[[Letter to Linda]] ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:The Forest locations]] [[Category:Fallout 76 locations]] [[fr:Tour relais HN-B1-12]] [[ru:Релейная вышка HN-B1-12]]
